database.description: Required when several databases are selected. Defaults to the sole selected database, or the database in a legacy connection string.

filter.description: Required query filter in Extended JSON. An explicit empty object matches every document. Strings may use mongosh literals such as ObjectId and ISODate.

update.description: An update operator document, such as {"$set":{"status":"shipped"}}, or its Extended JSON string. Alternatively, an update pipeline using $set, $addFields, $project, $unset, $replaceRoot or $replaceWith. Replacement documents and server-side JavaScript are refused.

upsert.description: Insert a document if no document matches the filter.

arrayFilters.description: Filters for positional array updates using $[identifier]. Available only with an update operator document.
